nodes.name: Twisted de Rham complex
nodes.statement: For a holomorphic function $f$ on a complex manifold $X$, the twisted de Rham complex is $\Omega_X^{\bullet}[\![\lambda]\!]_f = (\Omega_X^{\bullet}[\![\lambda]\!], \lambda d + df)$, where $(\lambda d + df)^2 = 0$.
nodes.statement_clean: Complex of formal power series in $\lambda$ with holomorphic-form coefficients and differential $\lambda d + df$.

nodes.name: Algebraic twisted de Rham complex
nodes.statement: For algebraic $X$ and $f$, the algebraic twisted de Rham complex is $\Omega^{\bullet}_{X^{\mathrm{alg}}}[\lambda]_f = (\Omega^{\bullet}_{X^{\mathrm{alg}}}[\lambda], \lambda d + df)$.

nodes.name: $\lambda$-filtration $\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}$
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}^j(\Omega^{\bullet}_X[\![\lambda]\!]_f) = \lambda^j \Omega^{\bullet}_X[\![\lambda]\!]_f$ for $j \geq 0$, with associated graded $\mathrm{Gr}^j_{\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}} \simeq (\Omega^{\bullet}_X, df)$.

nodes.name: $\mathcal{R}_X$-triple
nodes.statement: A triple $(\mathcal{M}', \mathcal{M}'', C)$ where $\mathcal{M}', \mathcal{M}''$ are $\mathcal{R}_X$-modules and $C$ is a sesqui-linear pairing $\mathcal{M}'_{|\mathbb{S}\times X} \otimes \sigma^{-1}(\mathcal{M}''_{|\mathbb{S}\times X}) \to \mathfrak{Db}_{\mathbb{S}\times X/\mathbb{S}}$.

nodes.name: Polarizable pure twistor $\mathcal{D}$-module
nodes.statement: An $\mathcal{R}_X$-triple $\mathcal{T}$ on $X$ satisfying the conditions of $\mathrm{MT}(X,w)$ — pure of weight $w$, polarized. Let $\mathrm{MT}(X,w)$ be the category.

nodes.name: Mixed twistor $\mathcal{D}$-module
nodes.statement: A filtered $\mathcal{R}_X$-triple $(\mathcal{T}, W)$ satisfying conditions so that $\mathrm{Gr}^W_w(\mathcal{T}) \in \mathrm{MT}(X,w)$. Category denoted $\mathrm{MTM}(X)$.

nodes.name: Integrable $\mathcal{R}_X$-triple ($\widetilde{\mathcal{R}}_X$-triple)
nodes.statement: An $\mathcal{R}_X$-triple $(\mathcal{M}', \mathcal{M}'', C)$ with $\mathcal{M}', \mathcal{M}''$ extended to $\widetilde{\mathcal{R}}_X = \mathcal{R}_X\langle \lambda^2 \partial_{\lambda}\rangle$-modules satisfying $\partial_{\theta} C(m', \overline{\sigma^{-1}(m'')}) = C(\partial_{\theta} m', \cdots) + C(m', \partial_{\theta} \sigma^{-1}(m''))$.

nodes.name: Category $\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{reg}}(X)$
nodes.statement: Full subcategory of $\widetilde{\mathcal{R}}_X$-modules $\mathcal{M}''$ such that $((\mathcal{M}', \mathcal{M}'', C), W) \in \mathrm{MTM}^{\mathrm{int}}_{\mathrm{reg}}(X)$ for some choice of data.

nodes.name: $\widetilde{\mathcal{R}}_X$-module $\mathcal{R}^F(M)$ from a filtered $\mathcal{D}$-module
nodes.statement: For a regular holonomic $\mathcal{D}_X$-module $M$ with good filtration $F$, set $R^F(M) = \sum_j \lambda^j F_j(M)$, naturally an $\widetilde{R}^F(\mathcal{D}_X)$-module; analytification gives $\mathcal{R}^F(M)$.

nodes.name: $\widetilde{\mathcal{R}}_X$-module $\mathcal{L}(f)$
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{L}(f) = \mathcal{O}_{\mathcal{X}}$ equipped with the meromorphic integrable connection $d + d(\lambda^{-1} f)$. Then $\mathcal{M}_f := \mathcal{M} \otimes \mathcal{L}(f) \in \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{reg}}(X)$.

nodes.name: Vanishing cycle $\phi_f$
nodes.statement: $\phi_f(\Xi_{\mathrm{DR}}(\mathcal{M})) = \bigoplus_{-1 < a \leq 0} \mathrm{Gr}^V_a(\iota_{f\dagger} \Xi_{\mathrm{DR}}(\mathcal{M}))$, the regular holonomic $\mathcal{D}_X$-module obtained from the $V$-filtration along $t = f$.

nodes.name: Spectral sequence of a filtered complex
nodes.statement: For a filtered complex $(K^{\bullet}, F^{\bullet})$, $E_r^{p,q} = Z_r^{p,q} / (Z_{r-1}^{p+1} + d Z_{r-1}^{p-r+1, q+r-2})$ with differentials $d_r: E_r^{p,q} \to E_r^{p+r, q-r+1}$.

nodes.name: Complex $\mathcal{C}_1(\mathcal{M})$ via $V$-filtration
nodes.statement: Total complex of $V_{-1}(\widetilde{\mathcal{M}}) \otimes \pi_{01}^{\ast}\widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}} \to \lambda^{-1} V_0(\widetilde{\mathcal{M}}) \otimes dt \otimes \pi_{01}^{\ast}\widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}}$ on $\mathbb{C}_{\lambda} \times X \times \mathbb{C}_t$.

nodes.name: Complex $\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M})$ with $u$-parameter
nodes.statement: Total complex on $\mathbb{C}_{\lambda} \times X \times \mathbb{C}_t \times \mathbb{C}_u$ from $\pi_{012}^{\ast} V_{-1}(\widetilde{\mathcal{M}}) \otimes \pi_{01}^{\ast}\widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}} \to \lambda^{-1} \pi_{012}^{\ast} V_0(\widetilde{\mathcal{M}}) \otimes dt \otimes \pi_{01}^{\ast}\widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}}$, $s \mapsto (u\partial_t + \lambda^{-1}) s\,dt$.

nodes.name: $\mathbb{C}^{\ast}$-action on $\mathbb{C}_{\lambda} \times \mathbb{C}_u$
nodes.statement: The action $a(\lambda, u) = (a^{-1}\lambda, au)$ inducing a $\mathbb{C}^{\ast}$-equivariant structure on $\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M})$, $\pi_{012}^{\ast} V_{-1}(\widetilde{\mathcal{M}})$, $\lambda^{-1}\pi_{012}^{\ast} V_0(\widetilde{\mathcal{M}})$.

nodes.name: $u$-filtration $\mathcal{F}_u$
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{F}_u^j \mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}) = u^j \mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M})$ with $\mathrm{Gr}^j_{\mathcal{F}_u} \mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}) \simeq \iota_{u\ast} \iota_u^{\ast} \mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M})$.

nodes.name: $E_1$-degeneration question for the formal twisted de Rham complex
nodes.statement: Does the spectral sequence for the filtered complex $\mathcal{F}_{\lambda} \Omega^{\bullet}_X[\![\lambda]\!]_f$ degenerate at the $E_1$-level?

nodes.name: Barannikov-Kontsevich theorem (quasi-projective)
nodes.statement: If $X$ and $f$ are quasi-projective, the $E_1$-degeneration for $\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}\Omega^{\bullet}_X[\![\lambda]\!]_f$ holds.

nodes.name: Barannikov-Kontsevich theorem (algebraic version)
nodes.statement: If $f: X \to \mathbb{C}$ is a projective morphism of algebraic varieties, then $\dim H^j(X^{\mathrm{alg}}, (\Omega^{\bullet}_{X^{\mathrm{alg}}}, df)) = \dim H^j(X^{\mathrm{alg}}, (\Omega^{\bullet}_{X^{\mathrm{alg}}}, d + df))$ for any $j$ and any $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$.
assumptions: $f: X \to \mathbb{C}$ is a projective morphism of algebraic varieties
conclusions: Equality of dimensions of algebraic twisted de Rham cohomologies for all $\lambda$

nodes.name: Pushforward preserves pure twistor $\mathcal{D}$-modules
nodes.statement: Let $F: X \to Y$ be a projective morphism of complex manifolds. For any $\mathcal{T} \in \mathrm{MT}(X, w)$, $F^j_{\dagger}(\mathcal{T}) \in \mathrm{MT}(Y, w + j)$.

nodes.name: Regular pure twistor pushforward (Kähler case)
nodes.statement: Let $F: X \to Y$ be a morphism of complex manifolds with $X$ Kähler. If $\mathcal{T} \in \mathrm{MT}_{\mathrm{reg}}(X, w)$ has support proper over $Y$, then $F^j_{\dagger}(\mathcal{T}) \in \mathrm{MT}_{\mathrm{reg}}(Y, w + j)$.

nodes.name: Pushforward preserves mixed twistor $\mathcal{D}$-modules
nodes.statement: Let $F: X \to Y$ be a projective morphism of complex manifolds. For $(\mathcal{T}, W) \in \mathrm{MTM}(X)$, $(F^j_{\dagger}(\mathcal{T}), W) \in \mathrm{MTM}(Y)$ for any $j$.

nodes.name: Regular mixed twistor pushforward (Kähler case)
nodes.statement: Let $F: X \to Y$ with $X$ Kähler. If $\mathcal{T} \in \mathrm{MTM}_{\mathrm{reg}}(X)$ has support proper over $Y$, then $F^j_{\dagger}(\mathcal{T}) \in \mathrm{MTM}_{\mathrm{reg}}(Y)$.

nodes.name: Main theorem ($E_1$-degeneration on Kähler manifolds)
nodes.statement: If $X$ is Kähler, the $E_1$-degeneration for $\mathcal{F}_{\lambda} \Omega^{\bullet}_X[\![\lambda]\!]_f$ holds.
assumptions: $f$ is a holomorphic function on $X$ with $\mathrm{Cr}(f)$ compact

nodes.name: Refined main theorem (with twisting by $\mathcal{M}$)
nodes.statement: The $E_1$-degeneration holds for $\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}(\mathcal{M} \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}})$ with respect to push-forward by $\mathcal{X} \to \mathbb{C}_{\lambda}$, yielding short exact sequences in cohomology for all $\ell, j$.
conclusions: Short exact sequences (\ref{eq;25.6.30.1}) hold for all $\ell, j$

nodes.name: Dimension equality with vanishing cycle cohomology
nodes.statement: $\dim H^j(X, \iota_{\lambda}^{\ast}(\mathcal{M}_f \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}})) = \dim H^j(X, \phi_f(\Xi_{\mathrm{DR}}\mathcal{M}) \otimes \Omega^{\bullet}_X)$ for any $j$.
conclusions: Dimension equality of restricted twisted cohomology and vanishing cycle cohomology

nodes.name: Reformulated $E_1$-degeneration via $\mathcal{C}_1(\mathcal{M})$
nodes.statement: The $E_1$-degeneration property holds for the filtered complex $\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}^{\bullet} \mathcal{C}_1(\mathcal{M})$ with respect to push-forward by $\mathbb{C}_{\lambda} \times X \times \mathbb{C}_t \to \mathbb{C}_{\lambda}$.

nodes.name: $E_1$-degeneration for $\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M})$ with $\mathbb{C}^{\ast}$-equivariance
nodes.statement: The $E_1$-degeneration holds for $\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}^{\bullet} \mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M})$ with respect to push-forward by $\pi_{03}$, and $R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}\mathrm{Gr}^j_{\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}} \mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M})$ are locally free $\mathbb{C}^{\ast}$-equivariant $\mathcal{O}_{\{0\} \times \mathbb{C}_u}$-modules of finite rank.

nodes.name: Equivalent forms of $E_1$-degeneration
nodes.statement: The spectral sequence for $\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}\Omega^{\bullet}_X[\![\lambda]\!]_f$ degenerates at $E_1$ iff the natural short exact sequences in cohomology of $\mathrm{Gr}_{\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}}^j$ and quotients hold; equivalently iff $H^{\ell}(X, \Omega^{\bullet}_X[\![\lambda]\!]_f) \simeq H^{\ell}(X, (\Omega^{\bullet}_X, df)) \otimes \mathbb{C}[\![\lambda]\!]$ as $\mathbb{C}[\![\lambda]\!]$-modules.

nodes.name: Filtered Hodge module gives $\mathcal{R}^F(M) \in \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{reg}}(X)$
nodes.statement: If $(M, F)$ is a filtered regular holonomic $\mathcal{D}$-module underlying a mixed Hodge module, then $\mathcal{R}^F(M) \in \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{reg}}(X)$.
assumptions: $(M, F)$ underlies a mixed Hodge module

nodes.name: Cohomological support contained in $\mathrm{Cr}(f)$
nodes.statement: The cohomological support of $(\iota_{\lambda}^{\ast}(\mathcal{M}_f \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}}))^{\sim}$ is contained in $0_X(\mathrm{Cr}(f))$, hence $H^{\ast}(X, \iota_{\lambda}^{\ast}(\mathcal{M}_f \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}}))$ is finite dimensional.

nodes.name: Vanishing cycle support compact
nodes.statement: The support of $\phi_f(\Xi_{\mathrm{DR}}(\mathcal{M}))$ is contained in the compact subset $\mathrm{Cr}(f)$, hence $H^{\ast}(X, \phi_f(\Xi_{\mathrm{DR}}\mathcal{M}) \otimes \Omega^{\bullet}_X)$ is finite dimensional.

nodes.name: Equivalence of conditions $A(r_0)$ and $B(r_0)$
nodes.statement: For $r_0 \geq 1$, the conditions $A(r_0)$: $H^j(F^{p,p+r}(K^{\bullet})) \to H^j(F^{p,p+1}(K^{\bullet}))$ epi for $0 \leq r \leq r_0$, and $B(r_0)$: $H^j(F^{p,p+r}(K^{\bullet})) \to H^j(F^{p,p+r-1}(K^{\bullet}))$ epi for $0 \leq r \leq r_0$, are equivalent.
assumptions: $(K^{\bullet}, F)$ filtered complex in abelian category

nodes.name: $d_r = 0$ characterized by condition $A(r_0)$
nodes.statement: $d_r = 0$ for any $1 \leq r \leq r_0 - 1$ if and only if condition $A(r_0)$ holds.

nodes.name: Fine resolution by Dolbeault complex (completed)
nodes.statement: The natural morphism $\widehat{\mathcal{M}_f \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}}} \to \mathrm{Tot}((\widehat{\mathcal{M}_f \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}}}) \widehat{\otimes}_{\mathcal{O}_X} \Omega^{0,\bullet}_X)$ is a fine resolution.
conclusions: The total complex computes the cohomology of the $\widehat{\,\,}$-completion

nodes.name: Cohomology of completion equals inverse limit
nodes.statement: The natural morphisms $H^j(X, \widehat{\mathcal{M}_f \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}}}) \to \varprojlim_{\ell} H^j(X, (\mathcal{M}_f / \mathcal{F}^{\ell}_{\lambda}\mathcal{M}_f) \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}})$ are isomorphisms.
conclusions: Compatibility of completion with inverse limit of cohomologies

nodes.name: Graph embedding identification
nodes.statement: There is a natural isomorphism $\widetilde{\mathcal{M}} \otimes \mathcal{L}(t) \simeq \iota_{f\dagger}(\mathcal{M}_f)$, inducing quasi-isomorphisms of the $\lambda$-filtered complexes and their associated gradeds.
conclusions: Quasi-isomorphism of complexes via graph embedding

nodes.name: Quasi-isomorphism $\mathcal{C}_1(\mathcal{M}) \to \widetilde{\mathcal{M}} \otimes \mathcal{L}(t) \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}$
nodes.statement: The inclusion $\mathcal{C}_1(\mathcal{M}) \to \widetilde{\mathcal{M}} \otimes \mathcal{L}(t) \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathbb{C}_{\lambda} \times X \times \mathbb{C}_t/\mathbb{C}_{\lambda}}$ is a quasi-isomorphism, inducing quasi-isomorphisms on $\mathcal{F}^k_{\lambda}$-subcomplexes and $\mathrm{Gr}^k_{\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}}$-quotients.

nodes.name: Local freeness of $R^{\ell}\pi_{0\ast}(\iota_u^{\ast} \mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}))$
nodes.statement: $R^{\ell}\pi_{0\ast}(\iota_u^{\ast} \mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}))$ are locally free $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{C}_{\lambda}}$-modules of finite rank for any $\ell$.
assumptions: $\mathrm{Gr}^V_a(\widetilde{\mathcal{M}})$ underlies a regular MTM with compact support

nodes.name: Exact sequence on $\mathbb{C}_{\lambda}^{\ast} \times \mathbb{C}_u$ (induction step)
nodes.statement: The natural sequences $0 \to R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathcal{F}_u^1 / \mathcal{F}_u^j) \to R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_u^j) \to R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathrm{Gr}^0_{\mathcal{F}_u} \mathcal{C}) \to 0$ are exact on $\mathbb{C}_{\lambda}^{\ast} \times \mathbb{C}_u$.
conclusions: Exact sequence over the open part $\lambda \neq 0$

nodes.name: Epimorphism $\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_u^{j+1} \to \mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_u^{j}$ on $\mathbb{C}_{\lambda}^{\ast} \times \mathbb{C}_u$
nodes.statement: $R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_u^{j+1}\mathcal{C}) \to R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_u^j\mathcal{C})$ are epimorphisms on $\mathbb{C}_{\lambda}^{\ast} \times \mathbb{C}_u$ for all $\ell, j$.

nodes.name: Cohomological support of $\widetilde{\iota}_{\lambda}^{\ast}\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M})$
nodes.statement: Let $Z$ denote the cohomological support of $(\widetilde{\iota}_{\lambda}^{\ast}\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}))^{\sim}$. Then $Z \subset (0_{X \times \mathbb{C}_t} \circ \iota_f)(\mathrm{Cr}(f)) \times \mathbb{C}_u$.

nodes.name: Vanishing of $\lambda$-jump morphism (stalk-level)
nodes.statement: The morphisms $R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}((\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_u^k\mathcal{C})/\lambda^j(\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_u^k\mathcal{C}))_{(0,0)} \to R^{\ell+1}\pi_{03\ast}(\lambda^j(\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_u^k\mathcal{C}) / \lambda^{j+1}(\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_u^k\mathcal{C}))_{(0,0)}$ are $0$.
conclusions: Boundary morphism vanishes at the stalk $(0,0)$

nodes.name: Vanishing of the boundary $b^{\ell}$
nodes.statement: The morphisms $R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}^j\mathcal{C})_{(0,0)} \to R^{\ell+1}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathrm{Gr}_{\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}}^j \mathcal{C})_{(0,0)}$ are $0$.
conclusions: Vanishing of the connecting morphism at $(0,0)$

nodes.name: $E_1$-degeneration in terms of epimorphisms
nodes.statement: The $E_1$-degeneration holds iff $H^j(F^{p,p+r}(K^{\bullet})) \to H^j(F^{p,p+r-1}(K^{\bullet}))$ are epimorphisms for any $j, p \in \mathbb{Z}$ and $r \geq 1$.

nodes.name: Exact sequence for $\mathcal{F}_u$-filtration
nodes.statement: The sequences $0 \to R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}\mathrm{Gr}^j_{\mathcal{F}_u}\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}) \to R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_u^{j+1}\mathcal{C}) \to R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_u^j\mathcal{C}) \to 0$ are exact for all $\ell, j$.

nodes.name: Coherence of $R^{\ell}\pi_{3\ast}(\widetilde{\iota}_{\lambda}^{\ast}\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}))$
nodes.statement: $R^{\ell}\pi_{3\ast}(\widetilde{\iota}_{\lambda}^{\ast}\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}))$ are coherent $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{C}_u}$-modules.

nodes.name: Local freeness of $a_{X\dagger}^{\ell}(\mathcal{M})$
nodes.statement: If $\mathcal{M}$ underlies a regular mixed twistor $\mathcal{D}$-module with compact support and $X$ is Kähler, then $a_{X\dagger}^{\ell}(\mathcal{M})$ are locally free $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{C}_{\lambda}}$-modules.

nodes.name: Free $\mathbb{C}[\![\lambda]\!]$-module structure of completion
nodes.statement: There exists an isomorphism $H^j(X, \widehat{\mathcal{M}_f \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}}}) \simeq H^j(X, \iota_{\lambda}^{\ast}(\mathcal{M}_f \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}})) \otimes \mathbb{C}[\![\lambda]\!]$. In particular, $H^j(X, \widehat{\mathcal{M}_f \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}}})$ are free $\mathbb{C}[\![\lambda]\!]$-modules of finite rank.

nodes.name: Equality $\dim H^j(X, (\Omega^{\bullet}_X, df)) = \dim H^j(X, \Omega^{\bullet}_X \otimes \phi_f(\mathcal{O}_X))$
nodes.statement: In particular, $\dim H^j(X, (\Omega^{\bullet}_X, df)) = \dim H^j(X, \Omega^{\bullet}_X \otimes \phi_f(\mathcal{O}_X))$.
conclusions: Dimension equality between $(\Omega^{\bullet}_X, df)$ cohomology and vanishing-cycle cohomology

nodes.name: Inverse-limit cohomology isomorphism
nodes.statement: $\varprojlim_{\ell} H^j(X, (\mathcal{M}_f \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}}) / \mathcal{F}^{\ell}_{\lambda}(\mathcal{M}_f \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}})) \simeq H^j(X, \iota_{\lambda}^{\ast}(\mathcal{M}_f \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}})) \otimes \mathbb{C}[\![\lambda]\!]$.
conclusions: Inverse-limit cohomology computed via tensor with $\mathbb{C}[\![\lambda]\!]$

nodes.name: Local freeness of $R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_u^j\mathcal{C})$
nodes.statement: $R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}) / \mathcal{F}_u^j \mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}))$ are locally free $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{C}_{\lambda}}[u]/u^j$-modules.

nodes.name: Coherence of $R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}^j\mathcal{C})$
nodes.statement: $R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}) / \mathcal{F}_{\lambda}^j \mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}))$ are coherent $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{C}_u}$-modules for any $\ell, j$.

nodes.name: Remark on equivalences in Lemma LP439.1
nodes.statement: The second condition trivially implies the first; the equivalence with $E_1$-degeneration is recalled in Section 3.1.4, and a generalized form (CP439.4) shows the first condition implies the second in the broader setting.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP439.3 (cohomological support)
nodes.statement: Compute supports of pulled-back $\mathcal{R}_X$-modules using the Koszul resolution and characteristic-variety hypothesis.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP439.4 (vanishing cycle support)
nodes.statement: Use that the regularity hypothesis on $f$ makes $\Xi_{\mathrm{DR}}(\mathcal{M})$ non-characteristic to $f^{-1}(c)$ off $\mathrm{Cr}(f)$, so $\phi_f$ vanishes there.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP439.5 ($A(r_0) \Leftrightarrow B(r_0)$)
nodes.statement: Induction on $r$ using a commutative diagram; $B(r_0) \Rightarrow A(r_0)$ is immediate.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP439.6 ($d_r = 0 \Leftrightarrow A(r_0)$)
nodes.statement: Induction on $r_0$ using a diagram with monomorphism $c$ and identifying the induced map $\varphi$ with $d_{r_0 - 1}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Corollary CP439.2 (free $\mathbb{C}[\![\lambda]\!]$-modules)
nodes.statement: Use the Dolbeault double complex with completion (LP439.7) and the inverse-limit identification (LP439.8) together with TP439.8.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP439.7 (fine resolution)
nodes.statement: Reduce locally to a quasi-isomorphism, use flatness of $C^{\infty}$ over $\mathcal{O}_X$ and pseudo-coherence; build sections inductively for compatibility with $\varprojlim$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP439.8 (cohomology of completion)
nodes.statement: Construct compatible cocycle representatives and coboundaries inductively in $\ell$, using the injectivity statement that follows from TP439.8.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP439.10 (quasi-isomorphism $\mathcal{C}_1 \to \widetilde{\mathcal{M}} \otimes \mathcal{L}(t)\otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}$)
nodes.statement: For $a > -1$, $\mathrm{Gr}^V_a \to \lambda^{-1}\mathrm{Gr}^V_{a+1} \otimes dt$ is an iso, hence the quotient of the inclusion is acyclic; second/third claims follow.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP439.11 (local freeness)
nodes.statement: Use Corollary CP439.1 for $\mathrm{Gr}^V_a$ and the canonical splitting (\ref{eq;23.3.29.10}) to derive long exact sequences and conclude by induction.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP439.12 (exactness over $\lambda \neq 0$)
nodes.statement: Construct sections $\widetilde{\alpha}, \beta^{(m)}, \gamma^{(m)}$ inductively using the splitting (\ref{eq;23.3.29.10}), giving $\hat{\alpha}$ representing $\alpha$ with $d\hat{\alpha} \in \mathcal{F}_u^{j+1}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP439.13 (epimorphism)
nodes.statement: Induction on $j$: base case from LP439.12, inductive step combining LP439.12 with the inductive hypothesis.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition PrP439.2
nodes.statement: Combine LP439.13 with the strictness of $R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}\mathrm{Gr}^j_{\mathcal{F}_u}\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M})$ established in LP439.11.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition PrP439.3 (coherence)
nodes.statement: Show the cohomological support $Z$ is contained in $0_{X\times\mathbb{C}_t} \circ \iota_f(\mathrm{Cr}(f)) \times \mathbb{C}_u$ (LP439.14) and is proper over $\mathbb{C}_u$, hence the pushforward is coherent.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP439.14 (cohomological support)
nodes.statement: Reduce to fibrewise statements at each $u$. For $u \neq 0$, use LP439.10 to identify with $\iota_{f\ast}\iota_{\lambda}^{\ast}(\mathcal{M}_{u^{-1}f} \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}[-1])$ and apply LP439.3. For $u = 0$, control via $V_0/V_{-1}$ and Koszul resolution.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem TP439.11
nodes.statement: Combine vanishing of $b^{\ell}$ at $(0,0)$ (LP439.16) with $\mathbb{C}^{\ast}$-equivariance to extend epimorphism property to all of $\mathbb{C}_u$, giving $E_1$-degeneration along $\pi_{03}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem TP439.7 from TP439.8
nodes.statement: Specialize TP439.8 to $\mathcal{M} = \mathcal{O}_{\mathcal{X}}$, recovering the formal twisted de Rham complex on a Kähler manifold.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem TP439.10 from TP439.11
nodes.statement: Specialize TP439.11 along $u = 1$ to obtain the $E_1$-degeneration for $\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}^{\bullet} \mathcal{C}_1(\mathcal{M})$.

nodes.name: Reduction of TP439.8 to TP439.10 via LP439.10
nodes.statement: Use the quasi-isomorphism of LP439.10 between $\mathcal{C}_1(\mathcal{M})$ and $\widetilde{\mathcal{M}} \otimes \mathcal{L}(t) \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}$, plus LP439.9, to transfer $E_1$-degeneration.

nodes.name: Construct $\widetilde{\alpha}$ extending $\alpha$ via splitting
nodes.statement: Using the splitting (\ref{eq;23.3.29.10}), construct $\widetilde{\alpha} \in \lambda^{-1}\pi_{012}^{\ast}V_0(\widetilde{\mathcal{M}}) \otimes dt \otimes \pi_{01}^{\ast}\widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}}[-1] \otimes \pi_1^{\ast}\Omega^{0,\bullet}_X$ inducing $\alpha$.

nodes.name: Define $\beta^{(0)} = d\widetilde{\alpha}$ in $V_{-N}$
nodes.statement: Set $\beta^{(0)} := d\widetilde{\alpha}$, which lies in $\lambda^{-1}\pi_{012}^{\ast}V_{-N}(\widetilde{\mathcal{M}}) \otimes dt \otimes \pi_{01}^{\ast}\widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}} \otimes \pi_1^{\ast}\Omega^{0,\bullet}_X$, with $d\beta^{(0)} = 0$.

nodes.name: Inductive correction $\beta^{(m)}, \gamma^{(m)}$
nodes.statement: For $m = 1, \ldots, j+1$ inductively construct $\beta^{(m)} \in u^m \lambda^{-1}\pi_{012}^{\ast}V_{-N+m}(\widetilde{\mathcal{M}}) \otimes \cdots$ and $\gamma^{(m)}$ with $\beta^{(m)} = \beta^{(m-1)} - d\gamma^{(m)}$ and $\gamma^{(m)} \otimes \lambda dt = \beta^{(m-1)}$.

nodes.name: Conclude with $\hat{\alpha} = \widetilde{\alpha} - \sum_m \gamma^{(m)}$
nodes.statement: Set $\hat{\alpha} = \widetilde{\alpha} - \sum_{m=1}^{j+1} \gamma^{(m)}$; then $\hat{\alpha}$ induces $\alpha$ and $d\hat{\alpha} \in \mathcal{F}_u^{j+1}\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}) \otimes \pi_1^{\ast}\Omega^{0,\bullet}_X[1]$, giving the lemma.

nodes.name: Base case $j = 1$
nodes.statement: By Lemma LP439.12, the epimorphism statement holds for $j = 1$.

nodes.name: Inductive step combining LP439.12 with hypothesis
nodes.statement:
Assume the epimorphism on $
bigf_u^1/
bigf_u^{j+1} 	o 
bigf_u^1/
bigf_u^j$ holds; apply Lemma LP439.12 to upgrade to $\mathcal{C}/
bigf_u^{j+1} 	o \mathcal{C}/
bigf_u^j$.

nodes.name: Case $u \neq 0$
nodes.statement: By LP439.10, $(\widetilde{\iota}_{\lambda}^{\ast}\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}))_u$ is quasi-iso to $\iota_{f\ast}\iota_{\lambda}^{\ast}(\mathcal{M}_{u^{-1}f} \otimes \widetilde{\Omega}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal{X}/\mathbb{C}_{\lambda}}[-1])$; apply LP439.3 to control its cohomological support.

nodes.name: Case $u = 0$
nodes.statement: Identify $(\widetilde{\iota}_{\lambda}^{\ast}\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M}))_0 \simeq \iota_{\lambda^{\ast}}(V_0/V_{-1}) \otimes dt \otimes \Omega^{\bullet}_X[-1]$; the support of $\iota_{\lambda\ast}(V_0/V_{-1})$ lies in $\iota_f(\mathrm{Cr}(f))$ via $df(X) \cap \mathrm{Ch}(\Xi_{\mathrm{DR}}(\mathcal{M})) \subset 0_X(\mathrm{Cr}(f))$.

nodes.name: Vanishing of $b^{\ell}$ at the stalk $(0,0)$
nodes.statement: By LP439.16, the boundary $b^{\ell}: R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}^j\mathcal{C})_{(0,0)} \to R^{\ell+1}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathrm{Gr}^j_{\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}} \mathcal{C})_{(0,0)}$ is $0$.

nodes.name: Local epimorphism near $(0,0)$
nodes.statement: Hence for any $j$ there exists $\epsilon > 0$ such that $R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}^{j+1}\mathcal{C}) \to R^{\ell}\pi_{03\ast}(\mathcal{C}/\mathcal{F}_{\lambda}^j\mathcal{C})$ is an epimorphism on $\{|u| < \epsilon\}$.

nodes.name: Extend via $\mathbb{C}^{\ast}$-equivariance
nodes.statement: The $\mathbb{C}^{\ast}$-action of DP439.15 promotes the local epimorphism to all of $\mathbb{C}_u$, giving the $E_1$-degeneration for $\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{M})$ along $\pi_{03}$.
